text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer... Ugh.
This is no time to be messing around like this...
choice_data_list: Get some proper rest today. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Where am I...? Wait, why am *I* here...!?

text_block_list.name: Apple
text_block_list.text:
Do not mistake me, Win Variation.
—I am an apple. The incarnation of an apple.

text_block_list.name: Apple
text_block_list.text:
"I've heard about you, Win Variation.
You revere apples so much that
you can't even bring yourself to eat them, is that right?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm just... not worthy of eating it
yet, so...

text_block_list.name: Apple
text_block_list.text:
"—Don't mock me! The apples... WE just want
to be eaten by you as soon as possible, damn it!!!"

text_block_list.name: Apple
text_block_list.text: And so, in order to make you someone who "can eat apples," I, an apple, will be personally training you. ...Looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
Are we... not done... yet...!?

text_block_list.name: Apple
text_block_list.text: "Hey now... Pooped after just 1,000 squats? Weak! That's sweet enough to give me diabetes!"

text_block_list.name: Apple
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I'm of a rather sour breed...
Don't expect me to be sweet like the rest of them!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Guh... What kind of apple is this?! I mean,
I do like strong tartness, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(And so, the strict yet fulfilling days
with me and the apple? passed by—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The autumn GⅠ, the 'Aomori Apple Cup'...
The winner is Win Variation!!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... I did it...!
I did it! Yaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Apple Master
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Congratulations, Win Variation.
...Good grief, juice is leaking from my eyes... Haha.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Master Apple...! I've... become one, yes!
Someone worthy of eating apples!

text_block_list.name: Apple Master
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true...
So—please, enjoy your meal.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes! Today's the day I take a big chomp out of Master's head... nom...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: …………Um, excuse me, Master.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm so emotionally attached to it, it's hard to eat it!!!

text_block_list.name: Apple Master
text_block_list.text:
Letting oneself be swayed by emotion, how immature...
Ugh... y-you utter fool...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
ââHuh!
Ah... a dream... yeah, figures.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Someday, I'll become
someone worthy of it too...!
